The '''Ualaq Pride''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed group of loyalist [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the group staged a number of attacks on the natives of Ando, in breach of the terms of the [[Treaty of Raquish]].
